mapper.select:
select * from (SELECT t1.FINPROD_ID secId, t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID marketId, t1.FINPROD_NAME secName, t1.FINPROD_ABBR secAbbr, sdl.ITEM_VALUE secType, MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME issuer, TO_CHAR(t1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, TO_CHAR(t1.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate, TO_CHAR(MBVI.LAST_PERIOD,'fm99990.00') ||'年' lastqx, MBVI.VALUE_SOURCE valueSource, TO_CHAR(MBVI.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') valueDate, TO_CHAR(t4.PAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') lastPaydate, sd.ITEM_VALUE rateType, TO_CHAR(ROUND(fccc.YIELD*100,4),'fm990.0000') ||'%' rate, MBCR.O_TYPE otype, sd1.ITEM_VALUE zxGrade, sd2.ITEM_VALUE ztGrade, t1.IS_RIGHT xqFlg, TO_CHAR(B.EXERCISE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') xqdate, TO_CHAR(MBVI.NETVALUATION_EXERCISE,'fm99990.0000') ||'元' priceXq, TO_CHAR(MBVI.NETPRICE,'fm99990.0000') ||'元' priceTj, PJ.INNEROUTER inOrOut, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBVI.BPYIELD*100,4),'fm99990.0000') ||'%' gzRate, sdltwo.ITEM_VALUE type2, sdlIssueType.ITEM_VALUE issueType, MCI2.CUSTOMER_NAME sponsorName, sdlCouponSpecies.ITEM_VALUE couponSpecies, sdlPayCycle.ITEM_VALUE payCycle, FCCR.BASIS basis, TO_CHAR(ROUND(t1.ISSUE_AMT/10000,2),'fm999999999999999999999990.00') || '万元' issueAmt, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBVI.M_DURATION,2),'fm9999999999999990.00') mDuration, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBVI.INTEREST_DURATION,2),'fm9999999999999990.00') interestDuration, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBVI.SDURATION,2),'fm9999999999999990.00') sDuration, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBVI.M_CONVEXITY,2),'fm9999999999999990.00') mConvexity, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBVI.BPVALUE,4),'fm9999999999999990.0000') bpvalue, CASE WHEN T2.TYPE_6 = 'B13' THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(t1.MDATE-t1.VDATE),2),'FM99990.00')||'天' else TO_CHAR(months_between(t1.MDATE,t1.VDATE)/12,'FM99990.00')||'年' end as deadline, TO_CHAR(ROUND(MBMI.MARKET_AMT/10000,2),'fm999999999999999999999990.00') || '万元' as secMarketAmt FROM FIN_PRODUCT t1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t2 ON t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO MBMI on t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=MBMI.SEC_ID
left join ( select mbvi_tmp.* from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER () over( PARTITION BY SEC_ID ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC, DECODE(VALUE_SOURCE, #{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC}, 1, 0) DESC ) rn, a.* FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO a WHERE to_char(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') AND VALUE_SOURCE IN (#{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC},#{VALUATION_SOURCE_SCH}) ) mbvi_tmp WHERE rn =1 ) MBVI on MBVI.SEC_ID=t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID
left join ( select mbvi_tmp.* from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER () over( PARTITION BY SEC_ID ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC, DECODE(T2.REGIST_ORG, #{REGIST_ORG_01}, 1, #{REGIST_ORG_02}, 1, 0) DESC ) rn, t1.* FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO t1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t2 ON t1.SEC_ID =t2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND t2.FINPROD_TYPE =#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01} AND DECODE(t1.VALUE_SOURCE, #{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC}, #{REGIST_ORG_01}, #{VALUATION_SOURCE_SCH}, #{REGIST_ORG_02}, 'NULL')=T2.REGIST_ORG WHERE to_char(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') AND VALUE_SOURCE IN (#{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC},#{VALUATION_SOURCE_SCH}) ) mbvi_tmp WHERE rn =1 ) MBVI on MBVI.SEC_ID=t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID
LEFT JOIN ( select f2.FINPROD_ID, min(f1.PAY_DATE) PAY_DATE from fin_cash_plan f1 inner join fin_cash_info f2 on f1.CASH_ID = f2.CASH_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT f3 on f2.FINPROD_ID = f3.FINPROD_ID where f2.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' and to_char(f1.PAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and f3.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' group by f2.FINPROD_ID ) t4 on t4.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID left join fin_cash_info t5 on t5.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t5.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' and t5.FINPROD_TYPE = '01' LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO t6 ON t6.CASH_ID = t5.CASH_ID AND to_char(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(t6.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fcc.YIELD as YIELD, fcc.FINPROD_ID as FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fcc WHERE EFF_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(f1.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE f1 WHERE to_char(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(f1.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') AND f1.FINPROD_ID=#{secId} ) AND FINPROD_ID=#{secId} ) fccc on fccc.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN mst_customer_info t7 ON t1.SPONSOR = t7.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN (
select A.FINPROD_ID,min(A.EXERCISE_DATE) EXERCISE_DATE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN A where to_char(A.EXERCISE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{secId}
group by A.FINPROD_ID ) B on t1.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR ON FCPR.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR ON t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MBCR.O_CODE AND MBCR.O_TYPE = '02' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sd1 ON sd1.DICT_CODE = 'MAIN_GRADE_RESULT' AND sd1.ITEM_CODE = MBCR.GRADE_RESULT LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCRA ON t1.ISSUER = MBCRA.O_CODE AND MBCRA.O_TYPE = '01' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sd2 ON sd2.DICT_CODE = 'MAIN_GRADE_RESULT' AND sd2.ITEM_CODE = MBCRA.GRADE_RESULT LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl ON sdl.DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR' AND sdl.ITEM_CODE = t2.TYPE_11 LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdltwo ON sdltwo.DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO' AND sdltwo.ITEM_CODE = t2.TYPE_9 LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdlIssueType ON sdlIssueType.DICT_CODE = 'ISSUE_TYPE' AND sdlIssueType.ITEM_CODE = t1.ISSUE_TYPE LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdlCouponSpecies ON sdlCouponSpecies.DICT_CODE = 'COUPON_SPECIES' AND sdlCouponSpecies.ITEM_CODE = t1.COUPON_SPECIES LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdlPayCycle ON sdlPayCycle.DICT_CODE = 'FREQUENCY_UNIT' AND sdlPayCycle.ITEM_CODE = FCPR.PAY_CYCLE LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sd ON sd.DICT_CODE = 'INT_TYPE' AND sd.ITEM_CODE = t6.INT_TYPE LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI ON t1.ISSUER = MCI.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI2 ON t1.SPONSOR = MCI2.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR ON FCCR.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM( SELECT OCODE, INNEROUTER, GRADEDATE, MSTRATINGRESULT01 GRADERESULT, rank() over ( partition BY OCODE ORDER BY gradeDate DESC ) rk FROM view_fin_product_rating ) WHERE rk = 1 ) PJ ON PJ.OCODE = t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN A ON t1.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID where 1 = 1
AND t1.FINPROD_ID = #{secId}
ORDER BY t6.EFF_DATE desc ) where rownum = 1

SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} )

SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} )

select distinct t2.ITEM_VALUE ITEM_CODE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN t1 inner join sys_datadict_list t2 on t2.DICT_CODE = 'EXEC_MODE' and t1.EXERCISE_TYPE = t2.ITEM_CODE where t1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F01} and t1.EXERCISE_TYPE in (#{EXEC_MODE_01}, #{EXEC_MODE_02})
AND t1.FINPROD_ID = #{secId}

select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, T8.REAL_NAME invManagerId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T4.type_11 secType1, T1.PS as ps, NVL(T1.ENTRUST_NUM,0) / 100 shareNum, T1.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, T1.PRICE unitPrice, T7.FULL_PRICE allPrice, T7.MATURE_YIELD*100 matureYield, T7.EXER_YIELD*100 exerYield, T7.SETTLE_SPREED as settleSpreed, T1.vdate etrDate, T1.REMARK as remark ,T1.INV_AIM as businessModel from ETR_ENTRUST T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM( FINISH_AMT) as FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T5 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T7 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER T8 ON T1.INV_MANAGER_ID = T8.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
AND T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

if.test: search != null and search != '' and search !='有效'

mapper.select: select T1.ccy,T1.Calendar_Id as calendarId,T1.vdate vdate,T1.mdate mdate,T1.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, T1.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr from fin_product T1 where T1.finprod_id = #{entrustId}

select
from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN pd where ROWNUM = 1
and pd.exercise_date >#{platDate}
and pd.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
and pd.exercise_type='02'
and pd.exercise_type='01'
and pd.EXERCISE_PRICE is null
order by pd.exercise_date desc

select sum( CASE WHEN b.S_HOLDINGTYPE=#{S_003} THEN a.AMOUNT*nvl(b.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END ) AS RRQMKDGH, /*融入券卖空待购回持仓*/ sum(CASE WHEN a.HODING_TYPE=#{A_004} AND a.DATE_TYPE ='0' THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS BFQTRKYCC from ETR_SEC_POSITION_RULE a LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG b ON a.HODING_TYPE =b.HOLDINGTYPE AND b.S_HOLDINGTYPE IN (#{S_003}) where to_char(a.cdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(#{cdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and (b.S_HOLDINGTYPE IN (#{S_003}) or a.HODING_TYPE in (#{A_004})) and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.date_type='0'
SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName from PTL_PORTFOLIO A where A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and rownum=1

select tt.portfolio_id as portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, inva.INV_AIM as businessModel, nvl(tt.entrustNum,0)/10000 as entrustNum from (select a.portfolio_id,a.finprod_id, sum(CASE WHEN b.S_HOLDINGTYPE=#{S_001} THEN a.AMOUNT*nvl(b.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END) as entrustNum from ETR_SEC_POSITION_RULE a LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG b ON a.HODING_TYPE = b.HOLDINGTYPE AND b.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_001} inner join ptl_portfolio_authority ppa on a.portfolio_id=ppa.portfolio_id
AND PPA.USER_ID = #{userId}
where a.cdate= #{platDate} and a.finprod_id=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.date_type='0' group by a.portfolio_id,a.finprod_id)tt
left join ( select FINPROD_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, listagg(INV_AIM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID) as INV_AIM from ( SELECT distinct FINPROD_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, INV_AIM FROM ( select a.INV_AIM , a.TRADE_DATE ,a.FINPROD_ID,b.PORTFOLIO_ID, ROW_NUMBER () over(PARTITION BY a.FINPROD_ID,b.PORTFOLIO_ID ORDER BY a.TRADE_DATE DESC) rn from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID =b.TRADE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.TRADE_DATE <= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 and a.trade_status='01' and a.is_cancel='N' ) WHERE rn = 1 union SELECT distinct a.FINPROD_ID, b.PORTFOLIO_ID, a.INV_AIM from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID =b.TRADE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.TRADE_DATE = #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.trade_status='01' and a.is_cancel='N' ) GROUP BY FINPROD_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID ) inva on inva.FINPROD_ID=tt.FINPROD_ID and inva.PORTFOLIO_ID=tt.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.portfolio_id=tt.portfolio_id where tt.entrustNum>0
SELECT count(*) from fin_product T1 inner join FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN p on p.finprod_id=T1.finprod_id where T1.is_right='Y' and p.exercise_date>#{platDate} and T1.finprod_id=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT distinct INV_AIM as businessModel,PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName FROM ( select a.INV_AIM , a.TRADE_DATE ,a.FINPROD_ID,b.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER () over( PARTITION BY a.TRADE_ID ORDER BY a.TRADE_DATE DESC) rn from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID =b.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on b.PORTFOLIO_ID=pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.finprod_id=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1 and a.INV_AIM is not null and a.trade_status='01' and a.is_cancel='N' ) WHERE rn = 1 UNION SELECT distinct a.INV_AIM as businessModel,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID =b.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on b.PORTFOLIO_ID=pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.INV_AIM is not null and a.trade_status='01' and a.is_cancel='N' AND a.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
select t2.transmit_time as transmitTime from etr_entrust t1 inner join etr_entrust_add t2 on t1.entrust_id=t2.entrust_id where t1.entrust_id=#{entrustId} and t1.entrust_status='05' and rownum=1

select distinct businessModel from ( SELECT a.INV_AIM as businessModel from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID =b.TRADE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.INV_AIM is not null AND a.TRADE_DATE <= #{platDate} and a.trade_status='01' and a.is_cancel='N' order by a.update_time desc) where rownum=1
